newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA- BIRZAI TO KEEP 1996 PROFITS IN COMPANY.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA- BIRZAI TO KEEP 1996 PROFITS IN COMPANY.

text.p: Birzai Dairy, one of Lithuania's leading dairies, said on Thursday that it planned to reinvest all of its 1996 profits to upgrade its production lines.

"We will propose to our shareholders at the general meeting next week to retain all of our profits from last year within the company," Birzai's general director Vladas Songaila told Reuters by telephone.
"We have already reached an agreement on this issue with our major shareholders," he added.
He said that the profits and the capital raised from the company's $6.0 million global depository receipt (GDR) issue last year would be used to upgrade production lines.
He said that the work would begin in April and be completed by June.
The company's unaudited results from 1996 showed a 1.9 million litas net profit versus 3.8 million litas the previous year.
